correctness.rationale: Reversible stationary weights G(k)=p^(−k) for nonnegative k and q^(−k) for negative k lead, on total net wealth K and aggregate debt d, to p^(−K)(q/p)^d. Conditioning on debt yields the exact finite composition count Z_N(K,d). For positive limiting wealth/credit densities the explicitly defined a,b satisfy E[Y+]=kappa+delta and E[Y−]=delta, while (Y,Y−) has full Z² lattice span (support includes (0,0),(1,0),(-1,1)) and nondegenerate covariance, so a uniform two-dimensional local CLT applies to compact interior parameters. The coefficient identity transforms debt L_N−s weights into u_N^s times lattice-probability ratios, converging for each s to u^s. Uniform Fourier point-mass O(1/N) and a lower CLT O(1/N) give geometric domination, establishing full reserve normalization and all fixed moments. Deleting finitely many coordinates yields the same local ratio and independent tagged accounts in total variation. Independently checked kappa=delta=1 gives a=3/4,b=2/3,u=(p/q)/2, e.g. p/q=.5 bank-empty probability 3/4. Proof needs p<=q to ensure u<1.
residual_risks: Uniform local CLT for triangular arrays uses standard lattice Fourier inversion; the compact-interior and full-span hypotheses are essential.
General equivalence-of-ensembles boundary occupancy literature may contain an alias of the geometric law.
No dynamics/mixing-time or p>q case is asserted.
